About 30 participants from Fiji, Australia and New Zealand, 12 of them on full
scholarships, came to the second IEEE GRSS New Zealand Radar Remote Sensing School at the
University of Canterbury, held from 15 to 17 April 2026. Rodrigo Gomez-Fell secured the
funding, led and organised the school, and taught two SAR laboratory sessions. More about the
school is on the [Teaching](../teaching.qmd#radar-school-2026) page.
